d: A feline humanoid with a mature, fierce expression and a lean, athletic build. The head features spiky jet black hair, a matching goatee, and pointed ears, while the eyes are a piercing golden yellow. The outfit consists of a brown leather chest piece with a red draped shawl, white trousers with geometric tan patterns, and brown boots. Two large crescent-shaped axes with gold accents and red gems are held in each hand. BODY COLOR: tan and brown LEGS: plantigrade with five-toed feet
